name: MonarchAiStarterPrompts
title: AiStarterPrompts
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Surface (with onClick) in rows built from androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row and Column, androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxWithConstraints
summary: Suggested ways to start a conversation, as cards in a grid or rows in a list. Choosing one hands the starter to the app.
whenToUse: On the empty state of an assistant, before the first message.
whenNotToUse: For follow-up suggestions after a reply use suggestion chips. For navigation between screens use a list of rows.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiStarterPrompts(prompts: List<MonarchAiStarterPrompt>, onSelect: (MonarchAiStarterPrompt) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, layout: MonarchAiStarterPromptsLayout = MonarchAiStarterPromptsLayout.Grid, enabled: Boolean = true, hidePrompt: Boolean = false, label: String? = null)
class MonarchAiStarterPrompt(id: String, title: String, prompt: String, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

options.name: prompts
options.description: The starters, most useful first. Each has an id, a title, the prompt and an optional decorative icon.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the starter the user chose.

options.name: layout
options.description: Grid: cards in as many columns of at least 208dp as fit, one column from font scale 1.5. List: full-width rows.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the starters can be chosen.

options.name: hidePrompt
options.description: Hides the prompt under each title.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the TalkBack name of the group, "Suggested prompts" (monarch_aistarterprompts_label).

states.name: pressed
states.description: The starter takes the hovered-subtle assistant fill and the assistant border; the change is animated only when animations are on.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Title, prompt and icon use the disabled text color and the border the subtle border color.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no starters nothing is shown.

appearance: Each starter is a surface card with the large radius, the surface fill and the default border; the title uses the label type and the prompt the caption type in the muted text color; the icon uses the strong assistant color. The same roles apply in every theme.
platformNotes: The parity map named LazyVerticalGrid; the starters are laid out in plain rows instead, because four to six of them sit inside a screen that already scrolls and a lazy grid cannot be nested in a vertical scroll. Cells in one row share their height, as in the web grid. The web tints a card on hover; touch has no hover, so the tint is the pressed state (a mouse hover also tints). onSelect receives the starter (the web passes the prompt and the starter). The icon is a composable slot, not an SF Symbol name as on iOS.
accessibility: The group is a traversal group with the content description "Suggested prompts".
Each starter is one button that TalkBack reads as its title and prompt; with hidePrompt only the title.
Each starter is at least 48dp high.
The icon is decorative and hidden from TalkBack.
The title wraps at large font sizes and the grid becomes one column from font scale 1.5.
edgeCases: The prompt is cut after two lines; TalkBack still reads all of it.
A last row with fewer starters keeps their width the same as the others.
